task.description: Re-validate the reworked design (rework iteration 1) after SECURITY-REVIEWER's INV-1 BLOCKER. Read handoffs/WF02-REQ037-20260817/step-02c-security-reviewer.json (the original finding) and handoffs/WF02-REQ037-20260817/step-01-rework1-code-designer.json (the fix CODE-DESIGNER claims to have applied) first, then independently read the revised lib/letflow/design/promotion_review_state_machine.md sections 2.3 and 2.8. Independently verify: (a) insert_review/2's design now derives tenant_id from opts[:prefix] via Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 rather than trusting the caller-supplied plan.target_tenant_id -- read tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's actual code yourself to confirm the claimed signature/behavior; (b) this genuinely satisfies docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's 2026-08-17 addendum -- read the addendum yourself, don't trust CODE-DESIGNER's citation of which option it adopted; (c) the new Sec 2.8 table's claim that the other 5 transition functions never assign to tenant_id is actually true by re-checking each function's own algorithm section. Also re-run the FULL standard gate checklist from scratch (not just the delta) since this is a rework re-check, not an incremental diff review.
acceptance_criteria: Independently confirm tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's real signature/behavior matches what the revised design assumes
Independently confirm the revised insert_review/2 design genuinely satisfies Decision 0003's 2026-08-17 addendum (read the addendum directly)
Independently re-verify the Sec 2.8 claim that the other 5 functions never touch tenant_id
Full standard gate checklist re-run (all 6 ACs mapped, signatures complete, no implementation code, cross-module deps listed)
FAIL again if the fix is incomplete or introduces a new gap -- do not pass on partial credit

result.summary: Independently re-verified the rework-1 design fix -- PASS, no partial credit needed. (1) Read lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:100-115 directly: tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 is pure (no I/O, no Repo call, guard-clause pattern match + Ecto.UUID.cast/1 only), @spec confirms {:ok, Ecto.UUID.t()} | {:error, :invalid_schema_name} -- matches exactly what the revised §2.3 assumes (return value, error atom, and 'pure' characterization). (2) Read docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's 2026-08-17 addendum in full: it names three candidate mechanisms and explicitly adopts only option (c) 'Derive it from the resolved schema at write time', rejecting (a) caller-supplied tenant_id for the exact attribution-integrity gap SECURITY-REVIEWER found, deferring (b) session-GUC. The revised §2.3 implements (c) precisely -- args.plan.target_tenant_id is no longer read for tenant_id at all (not even as a validated/rejected input), matching the addendum's own resolution rather than inventing a fourth validate-and-reject variant. (3) Independently re-checked §2.8's table against each of the 5 other functions' own algorithm sections: §2.4 approve_review/4's set: list (status, approved_by, approved_at, row_version), §2.5 reject_review/3 (status, row_version), §2.6 mark_review_applied/2 and mark_review_failed/2 (status, row_version each), §2.7 supersede_review/3 (status, superseded_by, row_version) -- none includes tenant_id; §2.2's shared generic algorithm (which all 5 route through) never appends a computed tenant_id to any set: list. Table's claim holds. (4) Full standard gate re-run from scratch: all 6 of REQ-037's acceptance_criteria (docs/requirements.yaml lines 1770-1775) map to a named concrete design element in §9's table, cross-checked against the actual requirement text, not just the doc's own restatement; every one of the 7 transition functions (insert_review/2, approve_review/4, reject_review/3, mark_review_applied/2, mark_review_failed/2, supersede_review/3, promote_definition/3) has a complete @spec with a closed @type error union naming every distinct error atom; no 'TBD'/deferral language on any in-scope element (the 6 open questions in §5 are legitimate out-of-scope flags per WF-02 Step 1's own 'open questions listed explicitly' acceptance criterion, not gaps in REQ-037's 6 ACs); no implementation code anywhere -- verified all 20 code fences in the file directly (awk-extracted every fenced block): only @type/@spec declarations and ASCII state-diagrams/dependency-diagrams appear, zero defmodule/def/defp bodies; §8 cross-module dependencies list is accurate and now explicitly includes the new Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 dependency insert_review/2 introduces (previously claimed as no direct dependency -- doc correctly flags this as a superseding correction, not a silent edit). No new gap introduced by the fix. PASS.
result.next_action: Route to ELIXIR-DEV (2a) for re-implementation of insert_review/2 per revised lib/letflow/design/promotion_review_state_machine.md §2.3/§2.8, then back through SECURITY-REVIEWER (2c) before REVIEWER (2d).
